Proud to submit M3 for Smart Beacons Catalyst proposal. In this PoA we have prepared a github repo with:
・Instructions on how to run the routing agent (with video)
・updated framework featuring decentralized routing agents.
・Testnet transactions demonstrating decentralized routing agent functionality can be found in the repository.
・Documentation that clearly outlines the decentralized routing process and Instructions on how to run the routing agent

Link to the repository: https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/smart-handles-agent/blob/main/README.md

Thank you for your feedback :)
We have added necessary documentation to this PoA. In the repo you will find
• The instructions on how to run the routing agents are under agent's repo, but under smart-handle's #off-chain-tools and #using-routing-contract, there are links to the two associated repos which have detailed instructions.
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/smart-handles?tab=readme-ov-file#off-chain-tools
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/smart-handles?tab=readme-ov-file#using-routing-contract
• Testnet transactions demonstrating decentralized routing agent functionality. These are mentioned under smart-handles-offchain repo, which in turn point the reader to the included example package's docs.
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/smart-handles-offchain/blob/main/example/README.md
